title: Remitly Expands Global Card Access to Customers Across the U.S. and Introduces Domestic Money Transfers
summary: Celebrates Milestone with Chance to Win Prize Money That Can Be Used Toward First-Class Tickets and Travel to Use Wherever Life Takes You Next
body_markdown:
*Celebrates Milestone with Chance to Win Prize Money That Can Be Used Toward First-Class Tickets and Travel to Use Wherever Life Takes You Next*


Customers have another reason to sign up for the Remitly Global Card. This week, Remitly is expanding card availability to eligible customers across the U.S., and we’re celebrating with a giveaway toward first-class tickets and travel to use wherever life takes you next.


For the first time, Global Card customers in the U.S. can also send and request money from one another anywhere in the country. Whether splitting rent, repaying friends or managing everyday expenses, customers now have a simpler way to move and manage money at home and abroad.


The new feature marks a significant milestone for Remitly, expanding services beyond international transfers and creating more ways to support customers’ everyday financial lives.


The Remitly Global Card combines one-of-a-kind features including our best remittance prices


to over 175 countries


, faster and lower-cost sends, no-fee everyday spending, a bank account for everyone, the ability to hold and move money in fiat currency or USDC, instant transfers between Remitly Global cardholders, no foreign transaction fees, SmartRate, eSIM, direct deposit, and global ATM access, among other features. Eligible customers can also access credit through the Remitly Global Card membership plan.


Customers can visit **[our website](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/home/remitly-global-card-sweepstakes)**


for sweepstakes details and eligibility requirements. There is no purchase necessary or Remitly account or Remitly Global Card required to enter or win.
